problem_title: How to query 'Value' of a picklist rather than the 'API NAME', using SOQL?
caption:
How to query 'Value' of a picklist rather than the 'API NAME', using SOQL?

🔴 The Problem: I am using SOQL to query the opportunity. When I use the query, I am getting the values under the API Name of the picklist items. How to get the value from the Values of the picklist?

✅ The Fix: You can use toLabel() to convert the picklist api name to a label: SELECT toLabel(CUSTOM_PICK_LIST_COL__C) FROM OPPORTUNITY
